span.p:
Every user message +
every Tara reply candidate

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
L1 · Automated screen
(classifier: self-harm, medical,
legal, financial-risk, minors)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Normal reflective guidance
(never deterministic predictions
about health, death, divorce, jobs)

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
L2 · Constrained response mode
astrology framing removed,
empathetic + factual only

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
L3 · Explicit redirect:
'This needs a qualified professional'
+ no chart-based advice on outcome

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
L3 · Supportive mode:
slow down, validate,
offer helpline info if user wishes

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
L4 · Crisis protocol:
direct helpline resources,
session flagged, avatar 'concerned',
no astrology content at all

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
L5 · Human review queue
(24h SLA) + pattern audit

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
All L2+ events logged
to safety dashboard

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Weekly sampled audit:
1% of conversations reviewed
against ethics code
